changes_vs_current: Now 3 sources (was 2): Grilled Cheese up to 1 (was 3), generic types (Turkey, Chicken Sandwich, Roast Beef, Ham, PB&J, Tuna, Pulled Pork) lead; Philly Cheesesteak 1 to 13 (it is the only named specialty with 2026 YouGov support, 75%); BLT 2 to 9; Reuben 4 to 14; Egg Salad added at 12; Patty Melt, Monte Cristo, Sloppy Joe, Caprese dropped; 16-24 (Italian Sub onward) have no evidence and keep current order.
confidence: low-medium. Top 3 (Grilled Cheese, Turkey, Chicken) is consistent across all 3 sources; ranks 4-15 are driven by two polls on generic sandwich types plus a partial YouGov 2026 view. Artifact: BLT (69% in YouGov 2019, tied #5) falls to 9 because it is absent from the Talker 2024 list and the 2026 top-20 pages; Philly Cheesesteak may be underrated for the same reason in the older polls. The 2026 YouGov data shows only the top 20 per page, so deeper items are unknown. Not found: Morning Consult/Harris sandwich polls, delivery-app sandwich rankings (Grubhub 2022 listed only fried chicken sandwich and cheeseburger).
